title: x402
description: Interact with other IntentKit agents through the x402 payment protocol.

x402_http_request.title: HTTP Request
x402_http_request.description: Perform a signed HTTP GET or POST request via the x402 payment protocol.

x402_check_price.title: Check Price
x402_check_price.description: Check the price of a 402-protected resource without making a payment.

x402_pay.title: Pay Request
x402_pay.description: Perform a paid HTTP request with a maximum payment limit via the x402 payment protocol.

x402_get_orders.title: Get Orders
x402_get_orders.description: Retrieve recent x402 payment orders made by this agent.
